lines.text: About the Authors
Ms.RaheelaAwais
Ms. Raheela Awais is a renowned educationist delivering her services in the capacity of
Principal in the public sector educational institution in Islamabad. With an excellent
academic record, she completed her Master's degree in Geography from the University of
Punjab. She holds a post graduate degree in Educational Planning and Management (EPM).
She has specialized skills in Inclusive Education. As a coordinator, she visited Indonesia for the
comparativestudyandimplementationof theInclusiveeducationproject.Shealsocompleteda
graduate levelcoursefrom the University of Oslo, Norway in Special Needs Education.
teacher's training workshops forprojects collaboratedwith international organizations likeIDp
Norway, Children Global Network (CGN), and Canadian International Development Agency
(CIDA). She has contributed as "Reviewer in discipline of Geography towards development of
curriculum at national/provincial levels with Curriculum Wing (ICT) and Punjab Textbook Board.
Additionally, she is the author of Social Studies Textbook developed for class 5th in Azad Jammu
& Kashmir. She also served as an author of Geography Textbook for class 6 to 8 developed by
tational BookFoundation.
queries about Chapter 3 and 6 please contact at: Raheela-Awais@hotmail.com.
Prof. Muhammad Javaid is working as Chairman, Department of Geography at Islamabad Model
Postgraduate College H-8, He did M.Sc. in Geography from University of Punjab, Lahore and
M.Ed.fromAiOUIslamabad.He joined educationdepartmentofFederal Government in1997.He
has taught Physical,and Regional Geography at Intermediate and Degree levels from 1997 to 2004
and Climatology, Oceanography and Geography of Pakistan to M.Sc. Geography classes from
2004to2021.Since2021,hehasbeen teaching differentcoursestoBSGeography.
He is co-author of Geography and Pakistan studies books for Middle and Higher Secondary levels,
published by NBF andAlOU respectively. He participated in a Training Course on ICT in Education
offered by IncheonMetropolitan City Office of Education, Incheon(Korea)in 2008.Hehas also
been a part of the Social Studies Curriculum development team for Grade 4 and 5 in2017.
For queries about Chapter numbers1, 2 and 4, please contact muhammadjavaid1970@gmail.com.
